text: dsh-better-keymap（DSH Web 插件）提供可搜索的快捷键界面，接管快捷键参考浮层并在通用设置中加入入口。用户可改绑应用命令和输入框中的发送、换行、Queue／Steer 动作；发生冲突时新分配接管按键，并提示被解绑的命令。支持搜索、单项恢复默认和全部恢复默认，配置按运行平台分别保存在浏览器本地。

A DSH web plugin with a searchable shortcut editor that replaces the shortcuts overlay and adds a General settings entry. Rebind commands and composer keys for send, newline, and Queue/Steer; conflicts release the old binding with a notice. Supports search and reset. Overrides are stored locally.
想让 DSH 的快捷键能按自己的习惯重新设置。
有没有地方可以搜索并查看 DSH 全部快捷键？
把一个快捷键分给新命令时，自动解绑原来的命令。
我想改掉发送消息和换行用的按键。
能不能恢复某个快捷键，或者一次恢复全部默认值？
I want to customize the keyboard shortcuts in DSH.
Can I search the shortcut list and change a binding?
Let me rebind the composer keys for sending and newlines.
搜索和查看快捷键：快捷键参考界面按应用、输入等分组列出命令，并支持搜索；按 Ctrl／⌘+/ 或设置页入口打开。
录制并改绑快捷键：点击命令行开始录制，按下新组合后提交；冲突命令会被解绑并在提示中列出。
重设输入框动作：可改绑发送、换行和互补 Queue／Steer 操作，插件通过键盘事件转换让新按键触发原动作。
恢复默认键位：可恢复某条命令的默认按键，也可清除当前配置中的所有覆盖；界面提示操作是否成功。
按平台和运行环境保存覆盖：配置区分 desktop/web 及平台，写入插件自己的本地偏好文档。

dsh-better-keymap README · Introduction：

English · 简体中文

dsh-better-keymap README · dsh-better-keymap：**v1.0.0** · for DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2+**

[](https://github.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap)
[](https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-better-keymap)
[](./LICENSE)

The better keyboard-shortcut manager for DeepSeek Harness. One editable table covers the vast majority of commands, **a later assignment overrides an earlier one**, and anything displaced is reported to you.

dsh-better-keymap README · Why：Harness refuses any edit that would conflict: try to move `Ctrl+N` off "new session" and it tells you the combination is taken, then declines to save. This plugin replaces that rule with **the later assignment wins** — the previous holder is unbound and named in a notice.

It also makes three actions rebindable that Harness ships as fixed keys:

| Action | Default |
|---|---|
| Send message | `Enter` |
| Newline | `Shift+Enter` |
| Complementary queue/steer | `Ctrl`/`⌘`+`Enter` |
dsh-better-keymap README · Why：Each can be moved to another key, or cleared so it triggers nothing.

dsh-better-keymap README · Install：```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-better-keymap
```

Then restart Harness. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the plugin manager installs it as a profile layer — **no configuration file needs editing.**

Installing from source instead:

```sh
pnpm add "github:Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap"
pnpm add "git+https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap.git"   # China mirror
```
dsh-better-keymap README · Install：`lib/` ships prebuilt, so no build step is needed either way. You can also install through **Plugins → Install plugin** in Harness and restart.

dsh-better-keymap README · Use：Press `Ctrl`/`⌘`+`/` to open the reference, then click a row's key to record a new combination. Release the keys to commit.

The reference is the product's own shortcuts page — same structure, copy, and interaction — served as an overlay that takes over the official entry point. Search, per-row reset, and restore-all-defaults all work as before.

dsh-better-keymap README · Rules：A bare key and two combinations are reserved, because Harness cannot dispatch them to an editable command without shadowing a fixed gesture:

| Reserved | Editable commands | The three input actions |
|---|---|---|
| `Enter` `Esc` `/` `@` `↑` `↓` | refused | `Enter` allowed, the rest refused |
| `Shift+Enter`, `Ctrl`+`Enter` | refused | allowed |

dsh-better-keymap README · Rules：Everything else is decided by Harness's own deliverability check. **A refused assignment writes nothing** — your keys and defaults are untouched, and the notice says why.

dsh-better-keymap README · Compatibility：| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2 and later |
| Node.js | 22.19+ or 24+ (only to build from source) |
| Profiles | `desktop` and `web`; verified on `desktop` |
| Host source | unmodified — the plugin uses only `ctx.shortcuts`, `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale` |

dsh-better-keymap README · Repositories：[GitHub](https://github.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap) (primary) · [Gitee](https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap) (China mirror) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-better-keymap)

dsh-better-keymap README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build        # writes lib/
pnpm run test         # 114 checks
```

English · 简体中文

dsh-better-keymap README · dsh-better-keymap：**v1.0.0** · 适用 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** 及以上

[](https://github.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap)
[](https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-better-keymap)
[](./LICENSE)

DeepSeek Harness 更好的快捷键管理。一个可编辑的键位表覆盖绝大多数命令，**后设置的组合自动覆盖先设置的**，被清空的快捷键会明确告知你。

dsh-better-keymap README · 它解决什么：Harness 自带设置页会**拒绝**任何造成冲突的编辑：想把 `Ctrl+N` 从「新会话」改给别的命令，它只会告诉你「已被占用」，然后拒绝保存。本插件把这条规则换成**后来者胜**——原先占用该组合的命令被解绑，并在提示里点名。

同时，三个原本固定的输入框动作也可以改绑或置空：

| 动作 | 默认键 |
|---|---|
| 发送消息 | `Enter` |
| 换行 | `Shift+Enter` |
| 使用互补的 Queue／Steer 方式 | `Ctrl`／`⌘`+`Enter` |

dsh-better-keymap README · 安装：```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-better-keymap
```

重启 Harness 即可。包内声明了 `dsh.bundle`，插件管理器会把它作为 profile layer 安装，**无需修改任何配置文件**。

从源码安装：

```sh
pnpm add "github:Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap"
pnpm add "git+https://gitee.com/Smallcarve/dsh-better-keymap.git"   # 国内镜像
```

`lib/` 已预构建，两种方式都不需要自己构建。也可以在 Harness 的 **插件 → 安装插件** 里填入包名，然后重启。

dsh-better-keymap README · 使用：按 `Ctrl`／`⌘`+`/` 打开速查表，点击某一行的按键后按下新组合，松开即提交。

界面就是 Harness 自己的快捷键页——结构、文案、交互一致——作为独立浮层取代官方入口。搜索、单行恢复默认、全部恢复默认都照常可用。

dsh-better-keymap README · 保留规则：有六个裸键和两个组合被保留，因为 Harness 无法把它们派发给可改键命令而不遮蔽固定手势：

| 保留项 | 普通命令 | 输入框三键 |
|---|---|---|
| `Enter` `Esc` `/` `@` `↑` `↓` | 拒绝 | `Enter` 可设，其余拒绝 |
| `Shift+Enter`、`Ctrl`+`Enter` | 拒绝 | 可设 |

其余取值交给 Harness 自己的可用性判定。**被拒绝的赋值不写入任何内容**——键位与默认值保持不变，提示会说明原因。

dsh-better-keymap README · 兼容性：| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上 |
| Node.js | 22.19+ 或 24+（仅自行构建时需要） |
| Profile | `desktop` 与 `web`；已在 `desktop` 上完整验证 |
| Harness 源码 | 未修改——只用公开的 `ctx.shortcuts`、`ctx.slots`、`ctx.locale` |
